mapper.select: SELECT slot_id,name,start_time,end_time FROM standard_time_slot WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY start_time

SELECT ep.engineer_id,u.display_name engineer_name,ep.bio,ep.average_rating,ep.review_count, ep.completed_count,ep.fulfillment_rate,ft.name skill_name,esa.service_area_id,es.schedule_id, es.service_date,st.name slot_name,st.start_time,st.end_time FROM repair_request rr JOIN engineer_skill esk ON esk.fault_type_id=rr.fault_type_id JOIN engineer_profile ep ON ep.engineer_id=esk.engineer_id JOIN system_user u ON u.user_id=ep.engineer_id JOIN engineer_service_area esa ON esa.engineer_id=ep.engineer_id AND esa.service_area_id=rr.service_area_id JOIN engineer_schedule es ON es.engineer_id=ep.engineer_id AND es.service_date>=rr.expected_date AND es.status='AVAILABLE' JOIN standard_time_slot st ON st.slot_id=es.slot_id JOIN fault_type ft ON ft.fault_type_id=esk.fault_type_id WHERE rr.repair_request_id=#{requestId} AND rr.customer_id=#{customerId} AND rr.status IN ('OPEN','BOOKED') AND ep.qualification_status='APPROVED' AND ep.employment_status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND ep.engineer_id<>rr.customer_id AND (rr.expected_slot_id IS NULL OR rr.expected_slot_id=es.slot_id) ORDER BY
ep.average_rating DESC,es.service_date,st.start_time ep.completed_count DESC,es.service_date,st.start_time es.service_date,st.start_time,ep.average_rating DESC (ep.average_rating*0.45+ep.fulfillment_rate/100*5*0.30+LEAST(ep.completed_count,50)/10*0.25) DESC,es.service_date,st.start_time
mapper.update: UPDATE engineer_schedule SET status='OCCUPIED',version_no=version_no+1 WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId} AND status='AVAILABLE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_status_log(order_id,operator_id,old_status,new_status,reason) VALUES(#{orderId},#{customerId},NULL,'PENDING_VISIT','预约成功自动创建工单')
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_request SET status='BOOKED' WHERE repair_request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification(receiver_id,notification_type,title,content,related_business_type,related_business_id) VALUES(#{engineerId},'NEW_APPOINTMENT','收到新的维修预约','客户已完成预约，请按时提供服务','APPOINTMENT',#{appointmentId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.status,a.schedule_id,ro.order_id,ro.order_status FROM appointment a JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.appointment_id=a.appointment_id WHERE a.appointment_id=#{appointmentId} AND a.customer_id=#{customerId} AND a.status IN ('BOOKED','PENDING_RESCHEDULE')
mapper.update: UPDATE engineer_schedule SET status='AVAILABLE',version_no=version_no+1 WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId} AND status='OCCUPIED'
UPDATE repair_order SET order_status='CANCELLED' WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_status_log(order_id,operator_id,old_status,new_status,reason) VALUES(#{orderId},#{customerId},#{oldStatus},'CANCELLED','客户改约，原工单关闭')
mapper.sql: appointment a JOIN system_user u ON u.user_id=a.engineer_id JOIN system_user cu ON cu.user_id=a.customer_id JOIN engineer_schedule es ON es.schedule_id=a.schedule_id JOIN standard_time_slot st ON st.slot_id=es.slot_id JOIN repair_request rr ON rr.repair_request_id=a.request_id JOIN fault_type ft ON ft.fault_type_id=rr.fault_type_id JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.appointment_id=a.appointment_id

SELECT a.status,a.schedule_id,ro.order_id,es.service_date,st.start_time FROM appointment a JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.appointment_id=a.appointment_id JOIN engineer_schedule es ON es.schedule_id=a.schedule_id JOIN standard_time_slot st ON st.slot_id=es.slot_id WHERE a.appointment_id=#{appointmentId} AND a.customer_id=#{customerId} AND a.status='BOOKED' AND ro.order_status='PENDING_VISIT'
